user.title: Cherkasyoblenergo outages
user.description: Find your personal account (особовий рахунок) by address, or enter its number.

street_search.title: Street
street_search.description: Type part of the street name, e.g. Шевченка.

account.title: Personal account
account.description: The number from your bill or the oblenergo cabinet.

queue.title: Hourly schedule queue
queue.description: Cherkasyoblenergo did not report a queue for account {account}. Check the number; if it is right, choose your ГПВ queue (sub-queue), e.g. 4.1.

error.invalid_account: Enter the account number as digits only.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.no_accounts: No personal accounts are registered at that address.

init.title: Queue
init.description: Leave on auto to use the queue Cherkasyoblenergo reports for the account. Choose a queue to override it.

error.invalid_queue: Use auto, or the form queue.sub-queue, e.g. 4.1.

unparsed_schedule.title: Could not read an outage schedule
unparsed_schedule.description: These Cherkasyoblenergo posts look like hourly outage schedules but no queue times could be read from them: {titles}. The post format may have changed; outage times for those days are missing.
